🔥 flipoff | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a free, browser-based emulation of a split-flap display for decorative or informational purposes on TVs and large monitors.
✨ Key Features: • Realistic split-flap animation with scramble transitions • Authentic mechanical clacking sound • Auto-rotating inspirational quotes • Fullscreen TV mode • Keyboard controls
📖 Summary: FlipOff is a free, open-source web application that emulates the look and feel of a classic mechanical split-flap display, commonly found in airports and train stations. It runs in a web browser, allowing users to turn any TV or monitor into a retro-style information board with realistic animations and sounds.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ teleop | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling intuitive, wireless teleoperation of robot arms using readily available mobile devices or VR headsets.
✨ Key Features: • WebXR-based teleoperation via phone or VR headset • Python server for receiving device data • Integration with robot arm controllers • Basic, xArm, and ROS 2 interfaces • Support for ROS 2 cartesian_controllers, MoveIt Servo, and IK solutions
📖 Summary: This repository enables teleoperation of robot arms using a phone or VR headset through a web interface powered by WebXR. It translates device orientation and position data into robot control commands, supporting various robot interfaces and ROS 2 integration.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 eventum | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating realistic synthetic event data for testing, demonstrations, and data pipelines.
✨ Key Features: • Realistic data generation using Faker and Mimesis • Flexible scheduling (cron, intervals, time patterns) • Multiple output destinations (stdout, files, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, HTTP) • Real-time streaming and bulk generation modes • Built-in web UI (Eventum Studio)
📖 Summary: Eventum is a Python-based data generation platform that creates realistic synthetic events for testing, demos, and data pipelines. It supports streaming events live or generating them in bulk, with flexible scheduling and multiple output destinations.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ CraftHub | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly interface for managing programming language class definitions and facilitating the creation, export, and comparison of JSON data structures.
✨ Key Features: • Class Upload and Creation • Custom Class Management • JSON Generation and Export • JSON Comparison (document changes and multi-file comparison) • Configurable difference detection (key order, array order, case, nulls, specific paths)
📖 Summary: CraftHub is a C# application built with Avalonia for .NET, offering robust tools for managing programming language classes and generating/comparing JSON data. It allows users to upload or create classes, save them, and then use these structures to easily generate and export JSON, with advanced features for comparing multiple JSON files.
